welcome: 🛡 Aegis Hello {name}! Aegis is a management and security bot for Telegram groups and channels. Use the buttons below to change the language or read the help.
help: ❓ Help Commands — each also works as a plain word, in English or Persian: /start — main menu (start · شروع) /config — your groups and channels and their settings (config · پیکربندی) /language — change the language (language · زبان) /help — this help (help · راهنما) /cancel — cancel the current step (cancel · لغو) In a group where Aegis is an admin, an admin can send «پیکربندی» or config to get a button to that group's private panel. To use Aegis in this chat you must first join its channels.
help_owner: 👑 Owner /panel — owner panel (panel · پنل): statistics, forced-join channels, broadcasts /staff — management (staff · ستاد): all chats, the bot team, audit log and seals, health, errors, queues, backups, system settings /status — Aegis's status (status · وضعیت) /shutdown — stop answering everyone but you (shutdown · خاموش) /activate — turn back on (activate · فعال‌سازی)
